[b][size=3]Credits and Permissions[/size][/b]

[b]🖼️ — ARTWORK & USAGE — 🎨[/b]

All artwork included in this mod was created by me. Please do not reuse, edit, reupload, redistribute, sell, or include my artwork or files in another mod without my explicit permission.

[b]👽 — THE AI TAG — 👽[/b]

[b]Download the mod or do not. You may decide for yourself how seriously any of this should be taken.[/b]

[i]I am using this tag on all of my mods, regardless of how the individual assets were made. I made this decision after people began applying the AI label to my work based on assumption, regardless of how the individual assets were actually created. The tag is not a confession that every asset was generated by AI. It is a tongue-in-cheek response to every mod page now needing to double as a courtroom exhibit proving that its creator possesses motor skills, because I have apparently reached the stage of my twenty-year creative career where strangers require a forensic investigation before believing a human like myself can actually create. I have decided to save everyone the trouble and tag the entire catalogue. Thank you to the concerned citizens who helped me discover this.[/i]
